- `title` (String)
- `trash_gid` (Number) GID with permissions to the trash folder (deprecated since 4.6)
- `triplication_enabled` (Boolean) Enables metadata triplication. Metadata triplication improves the resiliency of the cluster by allowing the loss of two metadata sections on SCM or DNode RAM at the same time without any loss of metadata or access. Enabling triplication improves resiliency at the cost of reducing the amount of metadata available to the system by 33%. In addition, enabling this feature increases write latency and reduces the max write IOPS of the system. Supported only on EBox clusters.
- `turbo_boost_flag` (Boolean) if enabled VMS will enable turbo boost during upgrade
- `upgrade_phase` (String) Phase of a background running upgrade
- `upgrade_progress` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--upgrade_progress))
- `upgrade_state` (String)
- `uptime` (String) Cluster uptime
- `url` (String) Endpoint URL for API operations on the cluster
- `usable_auxiliary_space_in_use` (Number) This is usable data that has been deleted logically and may be held by snapshots. Data is either reflected as auxiliary data because it was deleted recently and its deletion is still being processed, or it is reflected as auxiliary data because it is held by snapshots. Prior to deletion, data is reflected as used. After the data is deleted, if one or more snapshots that include that data still remain, the data is held by snapshot(s). It is no longer reflected as used and is now reflected as auxiliary.
- `usable_capacity_bytes` (Number) The usable capacity of the cluster, in bytes. This is always smaller than the physical capacity due to an overhead introduced by data protection. VAST Cluster protects data with RAID stripes. The data protection overhead varies by size of stripe which in turn varies based upon the number of storage enclosures (DBoxes) in a cluster.
- `usable_capacity_tb` (Number) The usable capacity of the cluster, in TB. This is always smaller than the physical capacity due to an overhead introduced by data protection. VAST Cluster protects data with RAID stripes. The data protection overhead varies by size of stripe which in turn varies based upon the number of storage enclosures (DBoxes) in a cluster.
- `use_flash_write_buffers` (Boolean) Whether to use Write Buffers on Flash (Spillover)
- `use_smb_privileged_group` (Boolean) If true, the privileged group is enabled. (deprecated since 4.6)
- `use_smb_privileged_user` (Boolean) If true, the privileged user is enabled. (deprecated since 4.6)
- `use_tenant_all_snapshots` (Boolean) Whether to use tenant all snapshots
- `used_handles_count` (Number)
- `used_handles_percent` (Number)
- `vast_audit_log_state` (String) State of Vast Audit Log table

- `wr_bw_mb` (Number) Write Bandwidth
- `wr_iops` (Number) Write IOPS
- `wr_latency` (Number) Write Latency
- `wr_latency_ms` (Number) Write Latency
- `wr_md_iops` (Number) Write Meta-data IOPS
